brightport_crescenzio.m: I am very busy, I hope you haven't intruded into the kitchen for some silly game.
r: Do you have butter or dough?

brightport_crescenzio0.m: Do you not like the menu? Ah, I understand. You wish for a taste of your hometown. Wherever you're from, I'm quite busy now, but if you could come back later, I could do it. Where are you from, child?

brightport_crescenzio1.m: Do I have? No. Do we have? Yes, quite a lot of both. But no, I will not give you any, if that's what you were about to ask. I have a great deal of work, and you'd do well not to intrude on it.

r: I would like you to cook me more.
I would like you to cook me more.
I would like you to cook me more.
I would like you to cook me more.
I would like you to cook me more.

brightport_crescenzio15.m: Hello child from Crossglen. Back for my cooking?
r: Yes, I want you to cook me some stuffed peppers.
Do you have butter and dough?

brightport_crescenzio2.m: Understood. Now, I wouldn't mind your presence here if we weren't so busy, so please leave.

brightport_crescenzio3.m: We're still swamped with work, but I haven't forgotten, child from Crossglen.

brightport_crescenzio4.m: Thanks to the delivery you made, we started baking the first batch of apple tarts for the festival. I can cook you a Crossglen recipe while I keep an eye on the oven.
r: What do you want to cook me?

brightport_crescenzio5.m: Delicious rice stuffed peppers. In Crossglen they'd make it with millet, but here we get rice from Nor City.

brightport_crescenzio6.m: To prepare some for you, I'll need peppers and rice. And an appropriate fee of 20 gold. The peppers come in different colors, and each affects the flavor, so I prefer to cook them separately.
r: I would like you to cook me some.
Here are 5 green peppers and rice.
Here are 5 yellow peppers and rice.
Here are 5 red peppers and rice.
I don't have the ingredients now, I'll be back again.
I would like you to cook me more.

brightport_crescnezio16.m: Ask my colleague Androni, he is working with the ingredients right now.

brightport_bakery.1: I've started some work for Allares at the bakery in Brightport. He asked me to help Delon down in the storage area.
brightport_bakery.5: I spoke with Delon and he's a real slacker. He wants me to do all sorts of work, all by myself.
brightport_bakery.10: He told me to start by sweeping the floor, and to do that I must find a broom.
brightport_bakery.15: The floor's all swept. I did it all by myself. Delon's "help" was more of a nuisance.
brightport_bakery.16: No wonder it got so quiet. Delon disappeared to sleep on some sacks. And now I have a new task, to sift through some flour.
brightport_bakery.19: I've sifted through all of the flour.
brightport_bakery.20: One last errand. An apple delivery hasn't arrived. I should ask Allares about it.
brightport_bakery.22: Allares refuses to accept my help until I prove my capabilities by bringing him one piece of deer meat.
brightport_bakery.23: After bringing the deer meat to Allares, he accepted my help, I should speak to Eatloni outside.
brightport_bakery.25: According to Eatloni, the order of 30 apples never arrived. I should visit Deebo's Orchard to check if the order had been picked up.
brightport_bakery.30: I went to see Deebo at the orchard. Apparently the merchant sent by Eatloni already picked up the apples.
brightport_bakery.35: I found some half-eaten apples in the woods north of the Duleian road.
brightport_bakery.40: I found two crates of apples. One was intact, but the other was empty. Did the mountain cats attack the merchant for food to feed their cubs?
brightport_bakery.45: I paid for a new shipment out of my own pocket. Deebo promised to hurry his workers and get them picked quickly. I should receive them from the orchard supervisor.
brightport_bakery.50: I received the apples from Alduan.
brightport_bakery.60: I brought the apples back to Eatloni. He reimbursed me for half the cost. Time to let Allares know I'm done with everything.
brightport_bakery.65: I brought the apples back to Eatloni. Time to let Allares know I'm done with everything.
brightport_bakery.70: I completed all the tasks at the bakery.

feygard_delicacy.1: Philippa, one of the lovely Feygard loyalist ladies from Wexlow that I rescued from Gamjee the troll has informed me that she is a master baker.
feygard_delicacy.2: Philippa has educated me about what a "Feydelight" is.
feygard_delicacy.3: In return for my helping to rescue Philippa, she's stated that she could make a "Feydelight" for me if I provide her with all of the ingredients necessary to bake one.
feygard_delicacy.4: I need to find dough, two eggs, wine, butter, honey and five Feygard fig fruits. I can find the figs in Feygard, but maybe I could find some along the Duleian Road too?
feygard_delicacy.5: She told me that I can find the dough in Brightport or Feygard, but I could find a baker in just about any town.
feygard_delicacy.6: Philippa told me that I can get honey from a beekeeper. But where to find one?
feygard_delicacy.7: I gave Philippa all the ingredients needed to bake the Feydelight. Now I just need to come back later.
feygard_delicacy.8: I have received my Feydelight from Philippa.
